description: Reviews Kintsua CLI commands that rewrite the committed MCP/OpenAPI tool lockfile or push captured tool schemas to a hosted service. Read-only diff and report runs stay automatic.
name: Kintsua command protection
saferAlternatives: Prefer `kintsua watch diff` and `kintsua watch report`, which only read the lockfile and history.
Review the classified change table before accepting a new baseline with `--update` or re-snapshotting.
